0xA6E97D1A:
Players have seven core attributes:
Kick, Control, Technique, Intelligence, Pressure, Physical, and Agility.
These influence outcomes in Mini-Battles, for Special Moves, and other key gameplay moments.
0x8DC42ED9:
Kick boosts a player's shooting ability and is especially important for Forwards.
It increases Shot Attack (Shot AT) and Focus Battle Attack (Focus AT),
making it the go-to stat for scoring more goals.
0x94DF1F98:
Control measures a player's ability to handle the ball and is important for all positions.
It adds bonuses to both Shot Attack (Shot AT) and Focus Battle Attack (Focus AT),
making it essential for advancing the ball from midfield to scoring positions.
0xDB9E895F:
Technique reflects how well a player competes for the ball and is key for Midfielders.
It boosts both Focus Battle Attack and Defence (Focus AT & DF),
helping your team keep control in midfield.
0xC285B81E:
Intelligence reflects a player's football IQ and tactical awareness.
It adds bonuses to Focus Battle Defence (Focus DF) and Scramble Attack/Defence (Scramble AT & DF),
greatly influencing the player's ability to win the ball.
0xE9A8EBDD:
Pressure shows how well a player disrupts opponents in close
challenges. It boosts Scramble DF for possession battles and
strengthens Castle Wall DF and KP to help block shots.
0xF0B3DA9C:
Physical is all about raw strength.
It improves Keeper Power (KP) and Castle Wall Defence (Castle Wall DF),
helping with goal defence and powering through physical plays.
0x772BC653:
Agility measures how fast and reactive a player is, especially for goalkeepers.
It boosts Keeper Power (KP) and Focus Defence (Focus DF), directly improving their shot-stopping ability.
0x6E30F712:
AT & DF represent Offence (AT) and Defence (DF) in Mini-Battles.
These values are calculated based on the seven basic attributes.
In Mini-Battles, the one with the higher AT or DF value wins their respective confrontation.
0xBE30266C:
Shot AT represents shot power and is the combined total of a player's Kick and Control values.
Special Moves or Shot Chains increase the Shot AT for the shot during which they are used.
0xA72B172D:
These values determine the outcome of Focus Battles.
Focus Attack (AT) is affected by Technique, Control, and Kick, while
Focus Defence (DF) is affected by Technique, Intelligence, and Agility.
0x8C0644EE:
These values represent the offensive and defensive strength used to determine the outcome of Scrambles.
Scramble Attack (AT) is calculated as the sum of Intelligence and Physical,
whereas Scramble Defence (DF) is the sum of Intelligence and Pressure.
0x951D75AF:
This value indicates the durability of the Castle Wall defence.
It is calculated as the sum of Physical and Pressure. When the ball hits a Castle Wall,
its Shot Attack (AT) is reduced by an amount equal to the Castle Wall's Defence (DF) value.

NAGUMOHARA Junior High is one of Kyushu's
top preparatory schools.
It focuses on both academics and
extracurricular activities.
The school's sport clubs regularly perform
well at tournaments.
0x0874BFCB:
In particular, the baseball club is the school's pride and joy.
They flourish on the national stage every year,
and were the runner-up at last year's
national tournament.
0x7F738F5D:
SAKURAZAKI, the notorious problem
child of NAGUMOHARA.
A stain on the school's good name...
Some call him scum and wish he would drop out.
0xE1171AFE:
NAGUMOHARA Junior High no longer has a football club.
For some reason, the club was disbanded,
and all records of why have been erased.
0x96102A68:
SAKURAZAKI got into another fight!
The thug he kicked went flying through the air.
What training's he doing for his legs to get that strong?
0x0F197BD2:
This problem child played football once...
It fits that a messy sport like football was his choice.

Delinquent's Shocking History
SAKURAZAKI was once wholeheartedly devoted
to football and never missed a day of practice...
0x781E4B44:
Since when does a middle schooler fight
genuine gangsters?!
Talk about an adolescent who either knows no fear,
or has given up on life!
0xE8A156D5:
SAKURAZAKI is heir to SAKURAZAKI Inc.,
one of the financial supporters of the school,
so he receives special treatment.
Power is a despicable thing.
0x9FA66643:
UMIBOZU statues appear all over NAGUMOHARA.
Seen as lucky charms and warding off evil,
they're usually found in busy spots.
0xFF61EFA6:
A worn-out football left unused.
Football has been banned at
NAGUMOHARA Junior High for five years,
making this ball a relic of the past.
0x8866DF30:
A massive tree at NAGUMOHARA Junior High,
which the students have dubbed the God Tree.
Legend says if you confess your love here unseen,
it will come true.
0x116F8E8A:
The baseball club is the pride of
NAGUMOHARA Junior High.
Regulars at nationals and
ranked among the top schools,
many students enroll just to join the team.
0x6668BE1C:
Since the new gym storage opened,
the old one's fallen into ruin.
The equipment inside is all abandoned and unused.
0xF80C2BBF:
The building includes a music room,
a multimedia room, a co-op store, and a cafeteria.
It boasts the nicest facilities of any junior high.
0x8F0B1B29:
The baseball club's dedicated storage.
Personal items are banned,
but footballs used in performances are kept here.
0x16024A93:
The storage used to store a variety of sports
equipment. Many clubs argue over its usage.
0x61057A05:
An old gym storage now a forgotten relic.
It's filled with discarded gear,
but could be put to good use with some tidying.
0xF1BA6794:
Mostly rooms for cultural clubs.
Every now and then,
noisy and quiet clubs clash over volume.
0x86BD5702:
A hospital staffed with skilled doctors,
trusted by the townsfolk.
0xD44CBC65:
Modeled after two dolphins that washed ashore
a few years ago, "Doll" and "Finn."
Their arrival caused quite a stir.
0xA34B8CF3:
Trains rarely pass here, but strange sightings
sometimes spark local urban legends.
0x3A42DD49:
A park where neighborhood kids gather to play.
Also a favorite hangout for stray cats.
0x4D45EDDF:
Mostly home to sports clubs,
this building sometimes hosts fiery clashes
between its passionate members.
0xD321787C:
Dance contest champion, RAIKA—
Some stake out the club just to watch her move.
But word is, she never actually shows up...
0xA42648EA:
A ghost member with unmatched pull—
Though listed on the club's roster,
she's been absent from activities
and now drifts as a ghost in name alone.
0x3D2F1950:
Undisputed star of the dance club—
Even if she skips, no one scolds her.
Her skills and results speak for themselves.
0x4A2829C6:
The school idol lost in thought—
RAIKA, a sophomore, was seen on the rooftop,
quietly gazing out over the town.
What could she be doing up there?
0xDA973457:
The dance club owes it all to RAIKA—
Her popularity is overwhelming.
Truthfully, its success
would be unthinkable without her.
0xAD9004C1:
Could she be from a shinobi clan—?
They say a mansion in NAGUMOHARA
houses the descendants of real ninja.
And her name is RAIKA...

A hot topic across town—
Locals were eager to see whether the new building
would go to the football or baseball club.
The whole town was watching with bated breath.
0xBA50BDB2:
A club that lived up to its name—
When equipment came crashing down in storage,
the football club rushed in to clean it up.
They proved their reputation wasn't just talk.
0x2359EC08:
Guardians of campus order—
When other students skipped cleanup duty,
the football club stepped in and handled it.
Proof that they were truly dedicated.
0xCA3A493D:
A lawless conflict—
The new facility controversy grew by the day,
dragging in students and parents alike.
What started as a club dispute became a full-blown feud.
0xBD3D79AB:

over the new school building.
Given the surrounding events,
no outcome could possibly satisfy both sides.
0x24342811:
Which club truly represents NAGUMOHARA Junior High?—
Even the parents joined in on the rivalry,
making things harder for students caught in the middle.
0x53331887:
The football club had the upper hand—
With their solid reputation, support kept growing.
The baseball club, seeing the tide turn, began to panic.

cast a long shadow over daily life,
prompting many residents to demand a swift resolution.

bringing the town-wide faction feud to an unexpected close.

Restoring the school's reputation—
After the football club was dissolved, teachers
have continued removing articles about the incident.
It's clear they still have a tough job.

The school's image—
Following the football club's incident,
the faction feud ended. While the outcome was favorable,
one can't help but wonder if this was truly the right resolution.

Did something good happen?

I'm curious about other flavors...

The legs that carry Nagasaki—
Lovingly called Ting-a-ling Trains by locals,
these trams have run over 100 years.
